Which check would let it send the mail without you?
Variety in, selection out, memory keeps
The human moves one level up
The better it gets, the less you watch

The full picture, and what it is made of

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 3 "The human moves one level up": line 31: "automatic when the groundedness judge passes and the goal-nudger scores high" comes closest: goal-nudger is named on the next slide (l.33), a forward pointer. Stays inside: the term is arc-earned in exercises/eval-loop.md and evals-as-steering.md (grep confirmed), same for line 21 "three stances and four detectors", "tactic file", "floor and ceiling". Harm (reader cannot resolve a term) absent. Also l.51 "one of these" resolves via l.53 "one piece of the work the loop produced".
line 13-17 "(Module 1)".."(Module 5)" are module-name pointers, spine vocabulary; no "the opening lecture"-style positional callback. grep 'opening|earlier lecture|last lecture' on body: none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 21 "the three stances and four detectors", line 23 "the tactic file", line 33 goal-nudger prompt: all resolve to existing beats (three-minds-one-synthesis.md, grounded.md/hallucination-bakeoff.md, eval-loop.md, evals-as-steering.md; checked by grep). Line 41 "a module of this course" is the author's own story, not a student beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/reveal demo beat, no live-demo setup on any slide

rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 5 l.39-43 "I drifted too" is the shortest content slide and carries a self-standing claim ("A check loop caught what the helpers missed. I caught what the loop missed."); every other chunk has 2+ lines of claim.

chunk 5 "I drifted too": l.41 "the rules sat in its context the whole time... leaks... across three helper agents" is the closest to contradicting its header, since the drifting shown is the agent's and helpers'; the header's title set is maintainer-sanctioned (l.76 blend note) and "I caught what the loop missed" ties the human in. Harm (reader misled about slide topic) marginal; see notes.

l.3 "Files are the handles. Connectors bring material in. Agents read and write. Judges hold a line. Loops make the next session sharper." is the closest: five short declaratives, each concrete (what it does), no shared anaphoric opener, no Not-X-Not-Y, no number+retraction, no self-grading superlative. grep '—' and banned_words CLEAN in body view.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: banned_words CLEAN (body view greps); grep -Ei 'beat|mood|compendium|surface|firing|forcing' on body → no hits. "goal-nudger", "tactic file", "yardstick" are course-earned terms, not repo dialect.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body lines 1-62 → 0 bold spans; budget of ≤1 per slide met.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: lecture is included in the agents-101 evaluations module (trainings/agents-101/evaluations.md:35 "Closing: The new human role in the loop") so it renders under .phase--lecture; all 8 chunks are `##` headings, slide_count 8 per body view; no phase-less prose section.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/lectures/new-human-role-in-the-loop.md → "OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent."

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/lectures/new-human-role-in-the-loop.md → "OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut." Closest in prose: l.35 "Ask the agent to build it with you:" followed by the prompt marker in the same chunk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links (has_urls false; check-slide-deixis --links reports none)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/lectures/new-human-role-in-the-loop.md → "slides: 8 limits: 210 words / 6 bullets, oversized: 0"; largest bullet list is chunk 1, 5 bullets (l.13-17).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: lecture headings: "The human moves one level up" (l.25, the law slide) is a claim as required; "Make the goal-nudger" (l.33) is an imperative task label inside a walk, "The full picture, and what it is made of" (l.55) an orientation/catalogue header, both exempt per the rule's NOT-violations list. Closest: l.7 "Which check would let it send the mail without you?" is a question, not a claim, but it opens a prompt-the-reader beat rather than a law slide.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: l.43 "That is why the loop still has a person in it." restates l.25-31's doctrine, but it ties the l.41 evidence to it and is the slide's only claim; l.61 closing line adds "conditions for giving the system more autonomy" (new content vs l.5 / l.29); l.23 supplies memory (tactic file) that l.21 never mapped. Classes (a)(b)(c) not present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: l.9-17 chunk 1: header changed to "Which check would let it send the mail without you?" (diff 4d9c4af2..HEAD) and the body was rewritten in the same edit, with l.11 "What would have to be true before you let the agent hit send?" added as the bridge; bullets 1-4 answer conditions rather than strictly checks, but they were re-earned, not inherited. Other renamed chunks (3, 5-8) were rewritten whole.
